bounded_deep_audit.falsifies_current_framing: Any source-pin drift, split assertion failure, leakage positive-control miss, source/frozen edit, full-run launch before review, or ablation report showing train-set scope or closer-to-fair criterion falsifies this freeze.
hardcoding_checks: no source edit to adjudicator/prereg/banked runner
no schema change to make failure disappear
no renderer/UI behavior used as evidence
bounded_deep_audit.insufficient_evidence: Tiny re-smoke metrics, normal/ablated score movement, passing synthetic adjudicator coverage, and design SHA do not establish H0/H1 or capability; they only show wiring.
bounded_deep_audit.mechanism_vs_behavioral_resemblance: The full run tests bounded learning/adaptation under baseline, ablation, leakage, and replay controls; it remains proxy evidence, not subjectivity or mechanism proof.
bounded_deep_audit.problem_definition_check: Existing Phase A smoke design/runner used train_eps for context_ablation_report and a closer-to-fair collapse flag; that is insufficient for Phase B because ablation must be measured on the same eval sets as headroom and eligibility.
bounded_deep_audit.rollback_plan: Delete the new Phase B freeze-review artifact directory; no source rollback is required because no source files are edited.
bounded_deep_audit.stop_condition: Stop before full run for freeze review; later stop with failure_manifest on any violated gate.
bounded_deep_audit.strongest_baseline_explanation: A cheap context-free, lookup/count_table, majority/predict_all, no-adaptation, or real graph_cache successor_map baseline may explain apparent success; if fair_max saturates the rung3 bar, report baseline_saturation instead of H1.
bounded_deep_audit.strongest_invalidity_reason: A model can look good because the ablation is evaluated off-target, the collapse criterion only moves closer to fair while preserving advantage, or a hidden second logic path feeds stale booleans into the adjudicator.

canonical_hash_scheme: sha256 over this object after recursively removing keys prefixed '_' and dumping JSON with sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True
claim_ceiling: Bounded retrieval-family rung3 transfer evidence on this TLGP world/grid only after the full run. This freeze review proves only design and smoke wiring. No mechanism validity, agency, self, subjectivity, consciousness, autonomy, AGI, EGO readiness, companion readiness, or runtime/mainline effect claim.

decision_statistic.H0: close_count(headroom_vs_meta <= DELTA) >= close_fraction_min after all gates
decision_statistic.H1: LCB(headroom_vs_meta) = mean - 2*std/sqrt(N_SEEDS) > DELTA after all gates and after baseline saturation check
decision_statistic.baseline_saturation: if rung3 fair_max >= ideal_mean - DELTA, report baseline_saturation before H1
decision_statistic.invalid: integrity, source, leakage, replay, eligibility, discriminativeness/ablation, split, underpowered, or inconclusive statistic failure

enabled_status: full 10-seed run not launched; freeze-review artifacts only until operator clears the frozen design

family_substitution.declaration: The validated retrieval_model replaces the prereg pooling primaries for this scoped run; H0/H1 are single-family retrieval-family decisions only.

FIX_1_ablation_eval_sets.description: context_ablation_report is run on eval/test sets, not train_eps
FIX_1_ablation_eval_sets.forbidden: train_eps ablation scope for Phase B gates

FIX_2_advantage_destroyed_collapse.EPSILON_source: pinned equal to prereg DELTA for Phase B freeze
FIX_2_advantage_destroyed_collapse.description: A mode collapses iff ablated_balacc <= fair_max + EPSILON on that same eval set; closer-to-fair is not sufficient
FIX_2_advantage_destroyed_collapse.forbidden: distance-to-fair, closer-to-fair, crossed-or-closer, or drop-only criteria
FIX_2_advantage_destroyed_collapse.per_rung_aggregation_rule: collapse_pass = count(collapsed_seed) >= close_fraction_min over MODEL_SEEDS; report per-mode counts and every seed row

mainline_integration_status: none; offline TLGP lab artifact path only, no EGO/runtime/UI/LLM/AIRI path
real_objective: Avoid wasting a 10-seed GPU run by freezing the corrected Phase B design before any result-bearing full-run launch, specifically fixing test-set ablation scope and advantage-destroyed collapse semantics.
real_trigger_evidence_required: After clearance, real trigger must be command invocation of the full run against this frozen design, with GPU env and artifact readback recorded. This freeze review itself is not the full trigger.

repo_readback.worktree_policy: pre-existing noisy untracked state allowed only as background; this task writes only the Phase B freeze-review artifact directory; no staging or commit

stage_1_rung1_eligibility.ablation: FIX-1/FIX-2 context ablation on rung1 test; both modes per seed; aggregate >= close_fraction_min
stage_1_rung1_eligibility.eligibility_rule: meta_balacc >= ideal_seen1 - DELTA on >= close_fraction_min seeds
stage_1_rung1_eligibility.gate: if eligibility/scanner/discriminativeness/leakage fails, STOP with failure_manifest and do not adjudicate rung3

stage_2_rung3_real.ablation: FIX-1/FIX-2 context ablation on rung3 unseen test; both modes per seed; aggregate >= close_fraction_min
stage_2_rung3_real.adjudicator_input: booleans and per-seed headroom supplied to unchanged rung3_single_family_adjudicator.compute_verdict
stage_2_rung3_real.headroom: ideal_mean - meta_mean per seed on rung3 test

stage_3_rung2_diagnostic.gating: reported diagnostic only; cannot upgrade or rescue H0/H1
stage_3_rung2_diagnostic.reuses: stage-2 rung3 trained model per seed
